title: Nvidia Releases RFD4-Proteina to Boost European Protein Research
summary:
Researchers and enterprises can now train robots and develop quantum computers on their own hardware following a series of software launches at GTC Berlin. The chipmaker is providing open models to allow teams in Europe to build specialized AI agents using their own local data and infrastructure to maintain control over their processing.

As part of this expansion, Nvidia and the University of Washington's protein design group introduced RFD4-Proteina. This open model helps design proteins and refine lab candidates for testing, which is intended to accelerate the development of new medicines and diagnostics.
